items.question: What is an eSIM?
items.answer: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM that allows you to activate a cellular plan without having to use a physical SIM card. It's built into your device and can be programmed with different carrier profiles.

items.question: How do I know if my device supports eSIM?
items.answer: Most modern smartphones support eSIM, including iPhone XS and later, Samsung Galaxy S20 and later, and Google Pixel 3 and later. You can check your device settings or visit our compatibility page for a full list.

items.question: How do I install an eSIM?
items.answer: After purchasing a plan, you'll receive a QR code. Simply scan it with your device's camera, follow the on-screen instructions, and your eSIM will be installed in minutes.

items.question: Can I use my regular SIM and eSIM at the same time?
items.answer: Yes! Most eSIM-compatible devices support dual SIM functionality, allowing you to use your regular SIM for calls and texts while using the eSIM for data.

items.question: What happens when my data runs out?
items.answer: You can easily top up your data plan through the Saily app. You'll also receive notifications when your data is running low so you're never caught off guard.

items.question: Can I share my data with other devices?
items.answer: Yes, you can use your phone's hotspot feature to share your eSIM data connection with other devices like laptops and tablets.

items.question: Do I need to be connected to Wi-Fi to install an eSIM?
items.answer: Yes, you'll need a Wi-Fi or data connection to download and install your eSIM profile. We recommend installing it before you travel.

items.question: How long does it take to activate an eSIM?
items.answer: eSIM activation is almost instant. Once installed, your eSIM will be ready to use within minutes.

items.question: Can I use Saily in multiple countries?
items.answer: Yes! Saily offers plans for 150+ countries. You can purchase country-specific plans or regional plans that cover multiple destinations.

items.question: What if I have issues with my eSIM?
items.answer: Our customer support team is available 24/7 to help you with any issues. You can reach us through the app, email, or live chat.

items.question: Is Saily secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. Saily is built by Nord Security, the team behind NordVPN. Your data and privacy are protected with industry-leading security measures.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Yes, we offer refunds for unused data plans. Please check our refund policy for more details or contact our support team.
